name: Pets In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that the life and soul of every living creature are held in God's hand, emphasizing His sovereign care over all creation (Job 12:10). The prophetic vision in Isaiah portrays a future peace where natural enemies, such as wolves and lambs, coexist harmoniously, suggesting a restoration of all creation in God's kingdom (Isaiah 11:6; 65:25). These passages affirm that God's redemptive plan extends beyond humanity to include animals, reflecting a renewed creation characterized by peace and safety.
